text: Hi, I'm Venkatesh, founder of THE Digital Moments. Let me show you exactly how Moments QR works — from a QR code at your wedding, to your very own wedding website.

Step one. Open your dashboard, and create a folder for each event — like your Reception. Add the date, and the album is ready. Then tap Generate QR code. You get a beautiful QR card, designed in your wedding's theme. Edit the words if you like, and download it.
Step two. Print it, and place it at your venue — at the entrance, or on every table. Guests simply scan it with their phone camera. No app. No login.
Step three. Guests pick their photos, write a little note for you, add a reaction, or even record a voice message — with their name, if they like. One tap on Share, and it's done.

Step four. Every photo goes straight into your wedding website. And yes, the website comes with it. Your names, your story, both your families, every event with the venue and directions — all on our signature template. Scroll down to Wedding Memories, and there they are: every moment your guests captured, in an album for each event.
So with Moments QR, you get two things in one: QR codes for every event, and your own wedding website. Want this for your wedding? Message me "MEMORIES", and I'll set it up for you.
